info.title: Ritten
info.description: A command line tool for running portable CI/CD workflows.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show every log entry in its highest detail. [default: False]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Show each step's outcome, but only failure detail. [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Rehearse the job without pushing, tagging, releasing, or commenting. [default: False]

options.name: --auto-approve
options.description: Approve a job up front, for runs with nobody there to confirm. [default: False]

commands.name: init
commands.description: Sets this repository up to run a Ritten workflow.

options.name: --check
options.description: Report what's missing or out of date without writing anything. [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: Rewrite the files Ritten generates, discarding local changes to them. Your own files are left alone. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show every log entry in its highest detail. [default: False]

arguments.name: WORKFLOW
arguments.description: The workflow to scaffold for. Derived from the repository when omitted.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Reports where the project stands: version, release state, and changelog.

commands.name: build
commands.description: Compiles and tests, without any release checks.

commands.name: install
commands.description: Builds, packs, and installs the tool globally from the working tree.

options.name: --force
options.description: Reinstall even when the installed version already matches the one just built. [default: False]

commands.name: prepare
commands.description: Stages the next release: rolls the changelog, sets the version, and formats.

options.name: --version
options.description: The version to prepare, in place of the one derived from the changelog.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Checks a pull request: formatting, version, changelog, compile, tests, and pack.

commands.name: deploy
commands.description: Checks, packs, tags, creates the GitHub release, and publishes to NuGet.
